Network-
Endpoint
in the role
unicastNetworkEndpoint
where an IPv6 Address is
configured in the
Ipv6Configuration
element.
• The Transport Layer Protocol used in the IPv4 Endpoint option and/or IPv6 End-
point option shall be derived from the Manifest where the
SomeipEventGroup
points either to
SomeipEventDeployment
s where the
transportProtocol
is set to
udp
or to
tcp
. The
SomeipServiceInstanceToMachineMapping
element that maps the
RequiredSomeipServiceInstance
to an
Ethernet-
CommunicationConnector
of a
Machine
the transport protocol and the port
number.
–
The
UDP
port shall be derived from
SomeipServiceInstanceToMa-
chineMapping
.
udpPort
. In case the port number (
SomeipServiceIn-
stanceToMachineMapping
.
udpPort
) is configured to 0, an
ephemeral
port shall be used. If the port number is configured to a value different from
0 exactly that value shall be used.
–
The
TCP
port shall be derived from
SomeipServiceInstanceToMa-
chineMapping
.
tcpPort
. In case the port number (
SomeipServiceIn-
stanceToMachineMapping
.
tcpPort
) is configured to 0, an
ephemeral
port shall be used. If the port number is configured to a value different from
0 exactly that value shall be used.
• The InitialDataRequested flag shall be set to 1 for fields and to 0 for events.
• Reserved shall be set to 0.
• Counter shall be set to 0.
⌋
Note:
In AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform (and ara::com) there are currently no use cases
in having parallel subscribes by the same subscriber to the same eventgroup of the
same service (, with the only difference being in the endpoint).
